title: Match: Resonant Sweep
brief: Match this sound: a filter sweeping back and forth with a strong resonant edge. Press "Play target" to hear it. Build VCO → VCF → Output, patch an LFO into the VCF's "CV" jack, and turn the VCF's "Amt" knob up — with Amt at zero the LFO reaches the filter but has nothing to move. Then push Resonance up until the sweep starts to sing rather than just brighten and darken.
